{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to ensure highest sample_seq is kept
data = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
data = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Filter for control arm and moderate severity
control_moderate = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Step 4: Compute the fraction of responders
n_responded = control_moderate['responded'].sum()
n_total = len(control_moderate)
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

# Print the exact values used in evidence — one per line, no formatting
print(n_responded)
print(n_total)
print(fraction_responded)

# Also print the final rounded value to confirm
print(fraction_responded)"}
